note: The one registry of standards, codes and union training programmes this platform teaches against. tools/eval_content.mjs scores every station's citations against it, tools/check_standards.mjs gates on it, and docs/standards/README.md renders it. A clause number is never invented: where the citation form is not certain, source is "unverified" and the body and title carry the claim. scope lists the catalog categories a standard governs; cites lists the forms a station's own text is matched against.
